Title
Ph.D. Programs
Subhead
Shape the Future of Human Health with a Ph.D. in Biomedical Engineering.
Featured Image
Sections
At the Wallace H. Coulter Department of Biomedical Engineering, your Ph.D. journey is more than a degree—it's a launchpad for transformative impact. Jointly offered by Georgia Tech and Emory University, our full-time doctoral programs immerse you in cutting-edge research at the crossroads of engineering, biology, and medicine. You’ll collaborate with world-renowned faculty, gain clinical and translational experience, and contribute to discoveries that improve lives. Whether you're aiming for a career in academia, industry, or entrepreneurship, Coulter BME equips you with the skills, mentorship, and vision to lead.
Joint Emory/Georgia Tech Ph.D. in Biomedical Engineering
Emory University and Georgia Tech M.D./Ph.D. in Biomedical Engineering
Interdisciplinary Ph.D. Programs
Why Choose Coulter BME for Your Ph.D.?
Dual-Institution Advantage: Access Georgia Tech’s top-ranked engineering and Emory’s leading medical expertise.
Interdisciplinary Research: Engage in collaborative, cross-disciplinary work spanning engineering, life sciences, and healthcare.
Mentorship: Train under faculty pioneers in fields like AI, imaging, regenerative medicine, neuroengineering, and more.
Flexible Curriculum: Tailor coursework to your research focus and career interests.
Real-World Impact: Translate discoveries into clinical and commercial innovations.
Apply Today
Take the next step in your biomedical career and apply to a Ph.D. program at Coulter BME.
